orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: New orders appear here. Accept quickly to keep customers waiting less.
orders.empty.new.title: No new orders
orders.empty.new.body: New orders show up here as soon as customers pay.
orders.empty.active.title: Nothing in progress
orders.empty.active.body: Orders you accept appear here until you mark them fulfilled.
orders.empty.done.title: No completed orders yet
orders.empty.done.body: Fulfilled orders will be listed here.
orders.empty.cancelled.title: No cancelled orders
orders.empty.cancelled.body: Rejected and cancelled orders will be listed here.
orders.noAccess.title: You don't have access to orders
orders.noAccess.body: Ask the business owner to give you the orders permission.
orders.digital.hint: This is what you sent to the customer.
orders.exception.title: This order needs attention
orders.reject.title: Reject this order?
orders.reject.body: The customer will be refunded in full. They will see your reason.
orders.reject.placeholder: Tell the customer why, for example: out of stock
orders.fulfill.title: Mark this order as fulfilled?
orders.fulfill.body: Add a note for the customer, such as what was delivered.
orders.fulfill.bodyDigital: Add the content the customer receives, and a note.
orders.fulfill.contentHint: Codes, links or instructions. The customer sees this.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: Something about this order changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.REJECT_NOT_ALLOWED: This order can't be rejected now. Contact support.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.CONTACT_SUPPORT: This order needs Ciuna support. Contact support to continue.
errors.DELIVERY_CONTENT_REQUIRED: Add the digital content before marking this order fulfilled.
errors.NOTE_REQUIRED: Add a note for the customer.
errors.SESSION_NOT_ENDED: You can mark a booking fulfilled after the session has ended.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't reach Ciuna. Check your connection and try again.
